events.title: Former 리버풀 manager Don Welsh dies aged 78.

The Manchester derby at Old Trafford ends in a 1–1 draw at Old Trafford. 맨체스터 유나이티드 have now gone 11 league games without a win, and are now 17th in the First Division and just one point above the relegation zone. They would have fallen into the bottom three today had 밀월 managed to find a winner at Hillsborough, where they were held to a 1–1 draw by 셰필드 웬즈데이.
게리 리네커 scores a hat-trick in 토트넘 홋스퍼's 4–0 home win over 노리치 시티 in the First Division.
웨스트햄 유나이티드 sign Czech goalkeeper Ludek Miklosko from Baník Ostrava for £300,000. Miklosko, 28, has been capped 31 times by the Czech national side .

맨체스터 유나이티드 end their 11–match winless league run with a 2–1 away win over 밀월, who led the league five months ago but have now slipped into the relegation zone. 리버풀 are held to their second goalless draw in two weeks by 노리치 시티 at Carrow Road. 애스턴 빌라 boost their title push with a 1–0 home win over 셰필드 웬즈데이. In the Second Division, leaders Leeds beat Hull 4–3 at Elland Road.
노팅엄 포리스트 move closer to a joint record fourth League Cup triumph by beating Coventry 2–1 in the semi-final first leg at the City Ground.

Brian Hillier and Lou Macari are both fined after being found guilty of placing an illegal bet against 스윈던 타운. Hillier is also given a 6–month ban from football and is forced to resign as the club's chairman.
밀월, still battling relegation despite having led the First Division five months ago, sack manager John Docherty and his assistant Frank McLintock .
올덤 애슬레틱 defeat 웨스트햄 유나이티드 6–0 at Boundary Park in the first leg of their League Cup semi–final, all but guaranteeing their first ever Wembley appearance.
Striker Tony Cascarino pledges his future to relegation threatened 밀월 despite reports that he is to join 애스턴 빌라 or 맨체스터 유나이티드.
Lou Macari resigns after seven months as manager of 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 맨체스터 유나이티드 reach the FA Cup quarter finals with a 3–2 fifth round win at 뉴캐슬 유나이티드.
애스턴 빌라 move to the top of the First Division with a 2–0 away win over 토트넘 홋스퍼.
웨스트햄 유나이티드 appoint their former player Billy Bonds as manager.
First Division leaders 애스턴 빌라 lose 3–0 at home to 윔블던.
노팅엄 포리스트 reach the League Cup final for the second season running by completing a 2–1 aggregate semi–final victory over 코번트리 시티.
Fourth Division 케임브리지 유나이티드 reach the FA Cup quarter–finals after a 5–1 second replay victory against 브리스틀 시티.

애스턴 빌라 finish February as First Division leaders by two points from 리버풀 in only their second season following promotion. 찰턴 애슬레틱, 밀월 and 루턴 타운 occupy the bottom three places, with the two Manchester clubs directly above them. 리즈 유나이티드 and 셰필드 유나이티드 continue to lead the way in the Second Division. 스윈던 타운, 올덤 애슬레틱, 선덜랜드 and 블랙번 로버스 occupy the playoff zone, while 포트 베일 are emerging as surprise contenders for a playoff place that could be their key to First Division football for the first time in their history.
